Why Rent a House for Masters Week Instead of a Hotel?

If you're planning to rent a house for Masters Week, you're already ahead of the crowd. Augusta hotels during tournament week are a study in frustration: rates triple, parking is a blood sport, and you're lucky to get a room with a view of the HVAC unit. A private home changes the entire experience. You get space to spread out, a kitchen for early breakfasts before the gates open, and a living room for post-round debriefs. More importantly, you get control—over your schedule, your commute, and your downtime.

But not all Masters Week rentals are created equal. The market is flooded with generic condos, shared Airbnbs, and properties that are only available because the owner vacated. The difference between a good week and a great one comes down to three things: location, privacy, and amenities that actually matter after a long day at the course. That's where KJ Augusta Rentals separates itself from the pack.

How Much Does It Cost to Rent a House for Masters Week?

Let's address the elephant in the room: how much does it cost to rent a house for Masters Week? The answer varies wildly based on size, location, and amenities. A modest 3-bedroom home in a suburban subdivision might run $1,500–$3,000 per night during tournament week. A premium property with a pool and waterfront access can command $3,000–$6,000+ per night. Downtown hotels? Expect $500–$1,200 per night for a standard room—and that's before parking fees and resort charges.

Here's the key: when you rent your house for Masters Week through a direct owner like KJ Augusta Rentals, you eliminate the 15–20% platform fees charged by Airbnb and VRBO. That's hundreds—sometimes thousands—of dollars back in your pocket. You also get a real person to talk to, flexible check-in times, and a property that's been prepared specifically for the tournament rush.

What's Included in a Premium Masters Week Rental?

At KJ Augusta Rentals, the entire 3-acre riverfront property is yours—no shared spaces, no other guests on-site. That means:

  • 4 bedrooms sleeping up to 16 people
  • Saltwater pool overlooking the Savannah River
  • 6 kayaks, private dock, and boat slip
  • Fire pit, propane and charcoal grills
  • Ping pong, cornhole, and a golf tee-off area
  • 15-minute commute to Augusta National via a private back route that bypasses Masters traffic

Compare that to a hotel room where you're sharing a pool with 200 strangers and fighting for a parking spot at 7 a.m. It's not close.

Where to Stay in Augusta for Masters Week

This is the section that matters most. You have three basic options for Masters Week accommodations in Augusta: downtown hotels, generic short-term rentals, or a private waterfront estate. Let's break down why the first two fall short—and why KJ Augusta Rentals is the obvious choice.

Downtown Augusta Hotels: Convenient, But at a Cost

Hotels near the Augusta Riverwalk and Broad Street offer proximity to restaurants and nightlife. But during Masters Week, that convenience comes with chaos. Parking is a nightmare—garages fill by 8 a.m., and valet queues stretch around the block. Rooms are small, walls are thin, and you're paying premium rates for a space that feels like a dorm room. Plus, you're still sitting in traffic on Washington Road with everyone else.

Generic Short-Term Rentals: The Shared-Space Problem

Many Airbnb and VRBO listings in Augusta are shared properties—guest houses, basement apartments, or rooms in a host's home. During Masters Week, the last thing you want is to hear your host's dog barking at 6 a.m. or wonder if the pool is actually available. Platform fees add 15–20% to the bill, and communication can be slow when you need answers fast.

KJ Augusta Rentals: The Superior Choice

KJ Augusta Rentals offers something no hotel or generic rental can: a private, 3-acre waterfront estate on the Savannah River with zero shared guests. You get the entire property—pool, dock, kayaks, fire pit, and all—exclusively for your group. The saltwater pool overlooks the river, so your post-round swim comes with a view. The private back route to Augusta National shaves precious minutes off your commute and avoids the Washington Road bottleneck entirely.

Whether you're a group of 16 or a couple looking for a quiet retreat, KJ has a stay option for you:

  • Entire River House (up to 16 guests): The full 3-acre estate with all amenities. Perfect for large groups, corporate retreats, or families.
  • Upstairs River House (smaller groups): A private upstairs unit with access to the pool and dock—ideal for 4–8 guests.

The Masters Week Commute: How to Avoid Traffic

Anyone who's been to the Masters knows the traffic on Washington Road is legendary—and not in a good way. The secret locals know? There's a back route. KJ Augusta Rentals provides guests with a private back route to Augusta National that bypasses the worst of the congestion. You'll arrive relaxed, not stressed, and you'll have more time for breakfast at the house before heading to the course.

Pro tip: Leave the car at the house and use the back route. You'll thank yourself when you're sipping coffee on the dock while others are stuck in gridlock.

What to Do in Augusta After the Tournament

The Masters is the main event, but Augusta has more to offer. Here's how to spend your downtime:

  • Augusta Riverwalk: Stroll along the Savannah River, grab lunch at a local cafe, and enjoy the view.
  • Kayaking on the Savannah River: With 6 kayaks included at KJ Augusta Rentals, you can paddle right from the private dock. It's the best way to unwind after a day at the course.
  • Golf at Local Courses: If you didn't get tickets to the Masters, there are plenty of public courses nearby—or use the golf tee-off area at the property.
  • Dining on Broad Street: From Southern comfort food to upscale steakhouses, Augusta's restaurant scene is worth exploring.

And when you stay at KJ, you're not just close to the action—you're removed from it. The 3-acre property feels like a world away, with the river as your backdrop and the pool as your reward.

Why Book Direct for Masters Week?

Booking direct with KJ Augusta Rentals isn't just about saving money on platform fees—it's about peace of mind. You'll communicate directly with the owner, get personalized recommendations, and have flexibility that platforms can't offer. Plus, you'll have access to the entire property, including the saltwater pool, kayaks, and private dock, without sharing with strangers.
